question:
I was released by my boyhood club at thirteen and later spent a loan spell in League Two with Wycombe Wanderers.
In 2025 I scored the only goal in an FA Cup final to win my club's first ever major trophy.
I've been managed by Steve McClaren & Patrick Vieira.

style.why: The question reads naturally and follows the house style well: it tells a story (released young -> loan in League Two -> FA Cup final hero) rather than listing stats. The hook is strong because being released at 13 is a memorable narrative beat for Eze, and the Wycombe detail adds specific intrigue.
style.fix: The main weakness is that the second sentence ('In 2025 I scored the only goal in an FA Cup final...') effectively gives away the answer to anyone who followed football in 2025, as Crystal Palace's first major trophy was a huge headline event. This makes it less of a puzzle and more of a recall test
